thread:
jon: quick heads up — customer reported weird billing blip during a mid-request truncation + toolcall fallback. putting details here.
priya: can you paste the timeline / logs?
jon: sure. short form: client requests long response, we truncate mid-stream (policy to protect latency). client reconnects to resume; router routes to a different shard; new shard performs toolcall to reconstruct prefix; billing shows provisional tokens from toolcall + confirmed tokens from original session.
leo: that sounds like the provisional-confirm path race again but with truncation thrown in. logs: ```
2026-03-20T09:44:01Z ingress: client=start session=sess_aa prefetch=pf_9
2026-03-20T09:44:03Z backend1: emit_chunk seq=1 tokens=+48
2026-03-20T09:44:05Z backend1: truncation triggered at seq=2 policy=latency_guard
2026-03-20T09:44:06Z billing: provisional tokens session=sess_aa tokens=+200 provenance=prov_zz
2026-03-20T09:44:07Z network: client reconnect session_hint=sess_aa
2026-03-20T09:44:07Z router: assign backend=backend2 (different region)
2026-03-20T09:44:07Z backend2: no kv cache -> toolcall fetch prefix toolcall_id=tc_77 tokens=+195 provenance=prov_zz
2026-03-20T09:44:08Z backend1: cleanup confirm ledger session=sess_aa tokens=+48
2026-03-20T09:44:09Z billing: final ledger confirmed tokens session=sess_aa tokens=+243
```
nate: interesting — backend1 confirmed only emitted chunks (48) but billing final is 243, so both provisional toolcall and confirmed chunk tokens got summed. we should expect dedupe or transfer.
priya: current ledger dedupe keys are: (ledger_entry_id). we don't tie provisional grants to session provenance or resume hints, so multi-backend resumptions get separate provisional grants.
jon: customer impact: invoice spike and support ticket. console shows "provisional spikes" in token chart but hard to correlate to session restarts.
leo: proposal: 1) add provenance_id (hash of session + prefetch_id + truncation_seq) to all provisional grants and toolcalls so different backends tag the same work unit. 2) when confirming ledger entries, collapse by provenance_id (keep max-confirmed tokens) instead of naive sum. 3) router: include resume_hint (provenance_id) when reconnects happen so new backend can attempt ownership transfer instead of fresh toolcall.
nate: we also need monotonic resume_seq per client session so we can tell newer confirmations supersede older provisional grants (handles out-of-order confirms across regions).
priya: console UX: add a toggle to overlay session-centric token timeline: show provisional vs confirmed per provenance_id, with links to request traces. add an alert rule for provisional > X and final delta > Y within T window.
jon: risk: changed collapse rule could undercharge if two independent work units accidentally share provenance_id. we should make provenance_id include backend-local nonce or include idempotency key from client if available.
leo: alternative short-term mitigations: - treat toolcall token grants as provisional with a longer hold window before confirmation, giving time to dedupe; - route reconnects preferentially back to original backend for affinity_ttl if backend reports cache still live.
ops-bot: alert: billing anomaly for customer=zephyr-labs, spike=+312 tokens in 2m, ticket=#T-5493 created.
jon: action items: Priya to prototype provenance_id tagging (PR + test vectors), Leo to add collapse-by-provenance to ledger confirmation logic (design doc), Nate to prototype resume_seq monotonic marker and router resume_hint propagation. I'll own the console overlay mock and support ticket updates.
priya: will include sample logs and a tiny harness that simulates truncation+reconnect+toolcall.
leo: i'll mock the ledger change locally and run replay to ensure no regression for independent sessions.
nate: will test cross-region confirm ordering and craft a canary rollout plan.
jon: thanks all — i'll post the internal ticket link when created and set a short-lived pager if we see more anomalies. :wave:
